Wallet dropdown Crypto item swapped its static generic.png for the same 4-icon rotation via a new .drop-crypto-icon class; Bank item swapped building-columns.svg for dollar-sign.svg. site.js's rotateGroup() helper replaces the single global .crypto-icon selector with two independently-scoped rotating groups.

Change: Fixed dropdown icon stacking; removed filters from dollar-sign
Detail: Drop icons switched from inset:0/margin:auto to top/left:50%+translate so they stack correctly regardless of the parent's display:flex. Removed filter:brightness(0)invert(1) from .crypto-icon--dollar and the bank dropdown's dollar-sign img so the icon renders as-authored.

Change: Embedded white fill in dollar-sign.svg; removed orphaned bank filter
Detail: dollar-sign.svg's fill switched from currentColor to a literal white so it renders correctly in context without a CSS filter. Removed the now-dead filter:brightness(0)invert(1) rule from the unused .crypto-icon--bank class.

Change: Replaced dollar-sign.svg with circle variant; normalized drop-icon sizing
Detail: Swapped in a user-provided green-circle dollar-sign SVG (self-contained, no external color needed). Bank drop-icon's redundant background:#1a5c38 removed from the span and its img resized to 32x32 to fill the .drop-icon container. Deleted the orphaned, unused .crypto-icon--bank CSS rule.

Change: Pointed dollar-sign references to crypto/ folder; restored solid/ as original Font Awesome file
Detail: All references to dollar-sign.svg now point to resources/icons/static/crypto/dollar-sign.svg (the green circle variant); resources/icons/static/solid/dollar-sign.svg restored to its original Font Awesome path-only source.

Change: Scaled drop-crypto-icons to fill their 32px container
Detail: .drop-crypto-icon changed from 18x18 centered via transform to inset:0 at 32x32; HTML img width/height attributes updated to match.

Change: Made drop-icon--rotating use display:block to match header logic
Detail: .drop-icon's default display:flex was interfering with its absolutely-positioned children; overriding to display:block lets inset:0 position the icons cleanly, matching the header .crypto-wrap pattern.

Change: Swapped border for box-shadow on rotating drop-icon to fix icon offset
Detail: border:1px was consumed by the 32px box under border-box sizing, over-constraining inset:0 and pinning icons top-left; box-shadow:inset renders the same ring without affecting box dimensions, so icons fill exactly.
flow-invoice.webp (205KB) and flow-invoice-full.webp (2.4MB) added for the deal-flow popup's Invoice step.

Change: Added hover scale animation to flow-step images in deal flow popup
Detail: Images expand to 1.1x with a 0.35s ease transition on hover, giving a subtle interactive feel without making them clickable.

Change: Fixed flow-step image hover clipping by wrapping images in an overflow:hidden container
Detail: The overflow-y:auto scroll host was clipping the scaled image on hover. Each img is now wrapped in a .flow-step-img div (overflow:hidden, border-radius) so the zoom effect stays self-contained instead of bleeding into the scroll container.

Change: Fixed flow image hover clipping by scaling the wrapper and adding a top padding buffer
Detail: Scaling the img inside overflow:hidden still clipped against the scroll host's top edge. Fix: scale .flow-step-img itself (the whole tile expands as a unit) and add padding-block-start:8px to .flow-panel-inner so the first row's top edge sits inside the clip boundary.

Change: Fixed flow-step-img: restored overflow:hidden and max-width to prevent oversized images
Detail: The wrapper needs overflow:hidden to clip the img to its aspect-ratio dimensions and max-width:120px to cap the wrapper size -- without these the img rendered at its natural/intrinsic size. border-radius moved from the img to the wrapper.

Change: Removed individual background boxes from flow-step icons
Detail: Each step in the deal-flow popup had its own faint background tile, making the row read as separate cards instead of one continuous flow on the modal's shared background.
flow-invoice.webp recompressed from 205KB to 42KB; added flow-repayment.webp (62KB) and flow-verification.webp (55KB) for the remaining deal-flow steps.

Change: Equalized hero CTA button widths when they wrap to stacked rows
Detail: Get Financing / Start Investing (and RU translations) had independent auto widths, so on narrow viewports where they wrap onto separate rows one button was visibly shorter. flex:1 1 auto lets a lone wrapped button grow to match the widest row's natural width while leaving the side-by-side layout unchanged.

Change: Fixed hero CTA equal-width fix to size to the widest button, not full width
Detail: flex:1 1 auto made a lone wrapped button's shrink-to-fit container collapse to the full row width, stretching both buttons edge-to-edge. Replaced with a resize-aware script that measures the two buttons' natural widths and, only when they've wrapped onto separate rows, sets both to the width of the wider one.

Change: Uploaded flow-financing and flow-yield webp images
Detail: flow-financing.webp (1.8MB) and flow-yield.webp (2.8MB) added, completing the image set for all five deal-flow steps.

Change: Backfilled changelog with 32 missing commit summaries
Detail: Caught up the CSV from 0e4aca9 (Add ru/legal/ directory) through 7ea977a (flow-financing/flow-yield webp upload) -- covering TVL card iterations, cookie banner tooltip removal, dollar-sign/crypto dropdown icon fixes, deal-flow popup image work, and hero CTA width equalization that had accumulated without changelog rows.

Change: Added a gold loader fallback for media that fails to load
Detail: New fallback-media.js swaps any or

Change: Showed the gold loader as a placeholder until media is ready, not only on 404
Detail: Reworked fallback-media.js so the spinner stands in for every tracked image and video from the start and is removed once the asset actually loads, covering slow loads as well as outright failures.

Change: Centred the loading spinner within the media slot
Detail: The loader was pinned to the top-left of the media box; positioning fixes centre it over the slot it replaces.

Change: Re-encoded the multi-size hero alpha videos
Detail: Replaced alpha-400_500, alpha-800_1000 and alpha-1600_2000 .webm renders with re-exported versions (slightly larger files) for the transparent hero animation.

Change: Added a coming-soon dev page and routed action buttons to it
Detail: New dev.html explains the site is not fully live yet and invites email contact, reusing the site's styles and auto-localizing to Russian. An initial dev-gate.js interceptor redirected action buttons there.

File(s): dev.html, js/dev-gate.js, en/index.html, ru/index.html, js/marketplace.js, js/en-features.js, js/popup.js
Change: Pointed dead-end buttons straight at the dev page and dropped the JS interceptor
Detail: Removed dev-gate.js in favour of direct links: footer social icons, wallet dropdown items, marketplace external and contribute links, and the popup invest CTA now navigate to dev.html. Also trimmed the dev page copy and removed the top badge.

Change: Routed the application form submit to the dev page and bumped the JS cache token
Detail: Replaced the apply-form fetch/validation handler with a redirect to dev.html and bumped changed scripts to ?v=demo4 so the CDN serves the new behaviour instead of a stale cached copy.

Change: Routed team cards to the dev page, restored the wallet dropdown and pointed Contacts at the team section
Detail: Team cards became links to dev.html; the Connect Wallet button reverted to opening its dropdown (only the dropdown items redirect); and the Contacts nav links, desktop and mobile, now jump to the #team section.

Change: Redesigned the team cards as portrait tiles matching the site
Detail: Replaced the cramped horizontal chips with vertical portrait cards: a full-width 4/5 photo with a scrim fading into the card body, then name, gold F0xMono role label and bio, plus a gold hover glow, lift, photo zoom and a corner arrow affordance. Responsive 3/2/1 columns. Bumped main.css to ?v=demo4.

Change: Made the mobile menu button keyboard-operable
Detail: The hamburger was a bare <label> over a hidden checkbox, so keyboard and switch users could not open the mobile menu. It is now a focusable role=button with aria-controls and aria-expanded that responds to Enter and Space; open and close labels are read from data attributes so each locale keeps its own wording, and Escape closes the drawer and restores focus to the button. Bumped en-features.js to ?v=demo5.

Change: Marked team member photos as decorative
Detail: Each team photo carried an alt of the person's name, which a screen reader announced on top of the same name already shown as card text. The photos now use an empty alt attribute so the visible name and role are read once.

Change: Localized the 404 page by request path
Detail: The not-found page now renders in Russian when the requested path is under /ru/ (or the browser language is Russian on a locale-neutral path), switching the page language, title, message and home links. English stays the default so the page still reads correctly with JavaScript disabled.
